notes: A1 and B1 are pilots with phase-locked 100ms sampling; ordinary pool occupancy averages from them are not representative.
A2 onward use 97ms sampling; fixed 100/s ordinary reads and 25/s ordinary writes use bounded independent-arrival workers.
Hot writers are closed-loop stressors, not a specified production arrival rate. All cohort latency includes unsuccessful started attempts.
Client-side dropped arrivals were never sent to the server and must not be counted as successful requests.
Each mixed phase has a 3-second warmup and a 20-second measured launch window; completion RPS counts successes before the window ends.
Raw snapshots are synthetic aggregate telemetry; no tokens, credentials, message bodies, identities or scope IDs.
